## Queue depth

Queue depth grows during the nightly reconciliation window and does not drain until mid-morning. Operators have been restarting consumers by hand to clear it, which works and hides the cause.

RECOMMENDATION (ticket INF-4471): make queue depth per consumer a first-class dashboard metric, because it is the number operators already act on.

## Retries

The retry policy is uniform across every consumer, so a slow downstream is retried at the same rate as a failing one. That turns a degraded dependency into an outage more often than any other single factor here.

RECOMMENDATION (ticket INF-5093): give each consumer its own retry budget, so a slow dependency degrades instead of cascading.

## Schema drift

Producers add fields without notice. Consumers tolerate unknown fields, so drift is invisible until a field is RENAMED, at which point the consumer reads null and writes a zero into a rollup nobody checks.

RECOMMENDATION (ticket INF-6218): fail closed on a renamed field rather than reading null, so drift surfaces at the boundary instead of in a rollup.
